    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        gain = call['loss_without_call'] - call['loss_with_call']
        normalized_gain = gain / call['prediction_tokens']
        accepted_bool = call['parseable'] and normalized_gain >= threshold
        diagnostics.append({
            'call_id': call['call_id'],
            'accepted': accepted_bool,
            'normalized_gain': normalized_gain
        })
        if accepted_bool:
            accepted.append(call['call_id'])
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
